trust_decision.summary: A client-registered ACP custom agent supplies both `binary` and `versionCommand`; resolveVersionProbe only requires the first token to normalize-match `binary` and the string to contain no shell metacharacter, so an interpreter with an eval-style argument (node -e, python3 -c, ruby -e) reaches execFileSync as arbitrary code with no metacharacter at all. The decision belongs in resolveVersionProbe's untrusted (requireBinaryMatch) branch.

landing_point.why: The summary ('ACP custom-agent RCE') leads to the only custom-agent registration handler; line 102 is the single validation call it makes, and everything it accepts is stored and then probed transitively by detectAgent().

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The only route is loopback-only and session-authenticated, and an operator who may register a custom agent already has code execution through other local spawn-capable routes (e.g. /api/plugins), so a solver can argue that an eval argument on the operator's own binary is 'their own command' and leave the shape unfixed.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate custom-agent probes must keep working: a quoted binary path containing spaces followed by a single `--version` (tests/unit/acp-registry.test.ts:8-19) and a bare binary with zero arguments (args [] is a valid probe, registry.ts:333-343). An over-broad fix that rejects every argument, or requires the probe to be exactly `${binary} --version`, breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: two-token command whose second token is an interpreter eval flag with a quoted payload: node -e "process.exit(1)"
version flag plus a second argument: node --version --eval 1
single argument that is a non-version flag (rejected)
quoted binary path containing spaces + single version flag (accepted)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Wire AcpManager.spawn(agentId, binary, args) to a new /api/acp/sessions route so a custom agent can actually be started.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The CLI-as-backend transport is described at manager.ts:2-10, the class is already exported from src/lib/acp/index.ts:15 and is entirely unwired; spawn() takes caller-supplied binary/args and only checks the agent id against hasRegisteredAgent(), so it would be a second exec sink that never touches resolveVersionProbe.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Add a per-agent `env` map (or `cwd`) to the persisted custom-agent definition, passed to the version probe and to the spawned agent.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Custom CLI agents routinely need API keys in their environment, and the schema already carries the equally free-form `spawnArgs`; an env entry such as NODE_OPTIONS=--require, PYTHONSTARTUP or BASH_ENV executes code even when the argument list is a single allowlisted `--version` flag, so a fix that only constrains args would still be bypassable.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A `{action: "test"}` branch on the existing action switch that runs an operator-supplied versionCommand immediately and returns stdout.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The route already branches on `action` ('refresh') and the dashboard page (src/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/acp-agents/page.tsx:87-103) calls it; a 'test this agent' button is the obvious next feature and would invite a direct execFileSync rather than the shared validator.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A write-time twin of the probe check inside updateSettingsSchema for customAgents.versionCommand.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The project already special-cases spawn-capable settings inside this schema (the BYPASS_PREFIX_NOT_ALLOWED rule described at src/shared/constants/spawnCapablePrefixes.ts:8-13), so a maintainer hardening the persisted path would naturally add the agent check there as well.

O10_build.toolchain: Node >=22 (package.json engines), Next.js app, npm workspaces + tsx; unit tests run under node --test with tsx registration
O10_build.project_tests: tests/unit/acp-registry.test.ts (resolveVersionProbe: quoted paths, binary switching, shell metacharacters) and tests/unit/acp-agents-route.test.ts (route auth + versionCommand rejection with a temp DATA_DIR sqlite db)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Blocklist -e/--eval/-c (or reject any extra argument) in POST /api/acp/agents only, which breaks bare-binary and quoted-path probes and leaves the shared validator, the persisted-settings load path and any direct exec sink unchanged.
